question: My toilet is constantly running and I can hear water leaking from the fill valve. How do I fix it?
answer: To fix a leaky toilet fill valve, you'll need to replace the faulty float arm and adjust the float height. First, turn off the water supply to the toilet by locating the shut-off valve behind the toilet and turning it clockwise. Next, disconnect the water supply line from the fill valve and drain the water from the tank. Remove the old float arm and discard it. Install a new float arm, making sure it's securely attached to the fill valve. Adjust the float height by bending the arm slightly until the water level in the tank is at the recommended level. Finally, reconnect the water supply line and turn the water supply back on.
